note: REAL raw socket.io frame captured via window.__SOCKET_SERVICE__.getSocket().onAny() during a live cancel-food-item on room order 1578881 (restaurant 69). Customer PII (names/phone/email) elided; diagnostic fields kept verbatim.
interpretation: The room order's socket payload carries order_from='pos' (NOT 'web') and rtype='RM'. orderTransform.order() -> isWebOrder = normaliseOrderFrom('pos')==='web' = false. hasUnconfirmedWebEditItems() is gated on isWebOrder, so the order is dropped from the ScanOrderPopOut queue on this refresh -> popup unmounts. get-single-order-new returns order_from=null for the same order, yielding the same isWebOrder=false. Table web orders instead carry order_from='web', so isWebOrder stays true and the popup persists.
